Existing reconstructionGram_eq_seedComplement and SeedModel.seed_correlations bind this literal matrix to sixI3-E*Eᴴ for every Seed. No strictness, determinant guard or completion hypothesis is needed for these equalities.

Matrix.inv_def and Ring.inverse_eq_inv already give adjugate divided by determinant, including totalized inverse at zero. The new adapter only changes the actual seed/determinant representation. Nonzero guards on StrictSeed are proved separately.

Archived NativeBlockInverse.nativeInverse_eq_nonsingInverse uses the same Mathlib facts but includes a different cyclic cofactor representation. No need to import or duplicate it: use Mathlib directly and retain Matrix.adjugate_fin_three for later entry expansion.
